id.description: A skill source's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adds the source, kept in lowercase.

url.description: A skill source's URL, as entered: https://, ssh:// or scp's [user@]host:path, naming a repository with an identity; no credential, query, fragment or leading hyphen, and no other scheme or local path. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule source-url and its reason; this pattern holds part of the rule, and cases/skill-source-url.json holds all of it.

identity.description: The URL's repository identity, which the source is known by with its folder.

folder.description: A folder of a repository, from its root: . for the root, else a relative path with no .. segment, kept with / between segments and no empty or . segment (a \ is read as /). Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule source-folder and its reason.

anyOf.description: A branch a skill source follows, as git takes a branch name: 1 to 255 characters with no white space, control character or any of ~ ^ : ? * [ \, no .. or @{, no empty segment, none beginning with . or ending with .lock, no trailing / or ., not @, and not beginning with -.

branch.description: The branch; null for the remote's default branch, the one its HEAD names.

oneOf.description: A branch the source syncs from, at start, every six hours and on Pull now.

commit.description: A git commit's full object name: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

oneOf.description: A commit the source is pinned to: it never syncs until it is unpinned.

follow.description: What a skill source follows: a branch (null for the remote's default), or a pinned commit, which never syncs.

position.description: Where the source stands among the environment's sources, in the order they were added, from 1: of two sources holding one name, the earlier wins.

kind.description: What caused the event: a client session, a routine, a provider adapter or the environment itself.

id.description: The actor's id within its kind; a system component names itself.

addedBy.description: Who added the source: the client session a person added it from, or the environment's own importer.

commit.description: The commit of its current snapshot, whose members are the ones in the set.

skillCount.description: How many valid members its current snapshot yields.

since.description: When the outcome began: the time of the skills.source-synced that recorded it, the source's add for its first.

oneOf.description: ok: the current snapshot is the commit the last sync fetched.

since.description: When the outcome began: the time of the skills.source-synced that recorded it, the source's add for its first.

problem.description: Why skills.probe could not reach the repository: authentication (the forge refused the credential, or asked for one no forge account gives), not_found (no such repository or branch), network (the host could not be reached in time), git_missing (git is not installed on the environment's computer; data.line holds the spawn's ENOENT), git_failed (git failed otherwise; data.line holds its fatal: line).

line.description: What git said when the outcome began, its fatal: line where it wrote one, scrubbed of every secret.

oneOf.description: failed: the fetch could not reach the repository, for the probe's problem; the last good snapshot stays current.

since.description: When the outcome began: the time of the skills.source-synced that recorded it, the source's add for its first.

commit.description: The commit fetched, at which the folder yields no valid member.

items.description: A folder of a repository, from its root: . for the root, else a relative path with no .. segment, kept with / between segments and no empty or . segment (a \ is read as /). Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule source-folder and its reason.

folders.description: The folders at that commit a source would read skills from, as the probe finds them; empty for none.

oneOf.description: layout_moved: the folder yields no valid member at the commit fetched, with the folders that would; the last good snapshot stays current.

sync.description: What a source's last sync came to and since when: ok; failed, with the probe's problem and what git said; or layout_moved, with the commit fetched and the folders that would yield skills. Failed and layout_moved keep the last good snapshot current.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

attemptedAt.description: When a fetch of the source (its add, a sync or a pin at a commit) last ended, whatever it came to; null when none has since the environment started. Kept outside the log: an unchanged sync moves it and appends nothing.

source.description: The source as skills.get listed it before.
